Puebla se prepara para recibirte en un torneo que pondrá a prueba tu nivel. **¿Estás listo para el desafío del 5x5?** El nombre del torneo no es coincidencia. El 5x5 representa un reto que exige estrategia, precisión y concentración. Así, el 5x5 se convierte en el corazón de este torneo, acompañado de otras categorías desafiantes. Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. **555 - Puebla 2026** es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **555 - Puebla 2026**! Puebla is ready to welcome you to a tournament that will test your level. **Are you ready for the 5x5 challenge?** The name of the tournament is no coincidence. The 5x5 represents a challenge that requires strategy, precision, and focus. That’s why 5x5 becomes the heart of this tournament, accompanied by other challenging events. This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. **555 - Puebla 2026** is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU5MDQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4cb58b9882a96f08b772fdbe40b22da459dd42c3/amcm_lateral.png) ### 🇧🇷 Português Campeonato Mineiro 2026, em parceria com a Associação Mineira de Cultura Nipo-Brasileira! Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$50. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para a modalidade 3x3x3. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$50. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. Registrations on the spot will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** **Bem-vindos à segunda competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!!** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2026 promete a consolidação do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo consolidar a representatividade também em um Esporte da Mente! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** **Welcome to the second speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!!** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMzAzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fac7617a993cc6636e9f89c013adf99c64048618/CaminosIrapuato.jpg) ##### *🎵"Di que vienes de allá, de un mundo raro, que no sabes llorar, que no entiendes de amor, y que nunca has llorado..."🎶* ## Caminos de Guanajuato – Irapuato 2026 La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** continúa su recorrido y hace escala en **Irapuato, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Este torneo forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo. En cada parada, la música de José Alfredo Jiménez acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a Irapuato. El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en Irapuato para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ## Caminos de Guanajuato – Irapuato 2026 The "Caminos de Guanajuato" route continues its journey and makes a stop in **Irapuato, Guanajuato**, a place that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and daily life intertwine in every corner. This tournament is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different locations under the same competitive and festive spirit. At each stop, the music of José Alfredo Jiménez symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have given voice to the Guanajuato spirit, inspire this edition dedicated to Irapuato. The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in Irapuato to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 80 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyNzIzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bf638126f96e668f65b37e3ce68edb80c6d49543/upen%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al UPEN Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de Nayarit!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 16 y domingo 17 de mayo de 2026. El UPEN Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Welcome to UPEN Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 16, and Sunday, May 17, 2026. UPEN Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: ![Speedcubing Austria Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgyMzE5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--484c13de9df904a57087f1d30b8dae0d69b0c2af/SpeedcubingAustria_Logo_comp_page.png) ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Frühling 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird von Speedcubing Austria sowie von Simon Praschl, Noah Kirrane und Julian Ostadal organisiert und von Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Viktor Kalmar und Fabian Staber delegiert. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Frühling 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Speedcubing Austria as well as Simon Praschl, Noah Kirrane and Julian Ostadal and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Viktor Kalmar and Fabian Staber. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Benoni May Madness 2026
items.information: **CubingZA** is excited to announce Benoni May Madness 2026!! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below for instructions and when registration opens. We will be having an odd mix of main, side and blind events in this One Day, One Stop, All-Out Total Non-Stop Action-Based Competition so be sure to stick around for all sorts of weird and unique tastes of skill, fortitude and perseverance!! **All New Competitors** If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. **Food and Drinks** Mova Coffee and Sweet N' Sweet will be available from the morning selling food and drinks. They will be around for the duration of the competition so be sure to get your food in between rounds and during lunch because part of being your own champion is competing at your best and not on an empty stomach!!!

Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir. * Alunos e funcionários da FECAP estão isentos da taxa de inscrição ***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 160 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.*** **Esta competição tem um limite de inscrições, portanto, caso tenha se inscrito e não possa mais participar, favor informar à equipe de organização, para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outro competidor.** **Utilização de imagem** Há possibilidade de filmagem e fotografias durante a competição, por parte da instituição de ensino ou veículos de mídia autorizados. Ao se inscrever, você concorda que sua imagem pode ser utilizada pela FECAP ou seus parceiros, com fins monetários ou não, sem compensação ou crédito necessário. Ao manter sua inscrição, você também reconhece a leitura e ciência deste aviso -------------------- ## English * The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab. * The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition. * Students and employees of FECAP will be waived from the registration fee. ***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 160 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by de date of payment.*** **This competition has a competitor limit, so if you have registered and will no longer be able to attend, please inform the organization team, so the spot can be given to another competitor.** **Image use** It's possible there will be photography and filming at the event, done by FECAP or authorized media outlets. By registering, you agree that your image might be used by FECAP or its partners, for monetary gain or other purposes, without compensation or credit necessary. By keeping your registration, you also recognize to have read and granted permission to this. ![Image description](https://i.postimg.cc/C1vLjXXn/logo-fecap.png)

items.information: Willkommen in der ehemaligen Hauptstadt – willkommen in Bonn! Zum allerersten Mal bringt ein Cubing-Turnier die Würfel-Community in diese traditionsreiche Stadt – und wir sind bereit, Geschichte zu schreiben. Freu dich auf ein Wochenende voller Spannung, persönlicher Bestzeiten, packender Finals und unvergesslicher Momente. Ob Newcomer oder Speedcubing-Profi – in Bonn wird gecubed, gefeiert und mitgefiebert! Sei dabei, wenn das erste Turnier in Bonn legendär wird. Melde dich jetzt an – wir können es kaum erwarten, dich dort zu sehen! Welcome to the former capital – welcome to Bonn! For the very first time, a cubing tournament is coming to this historic city – and we’re ready to make history together. Get ready for a weekend full of excitement, personal bests, thrilling finals, and unforgettable moments. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned speedcuber – in Bonn, we cube, we cheer, and we celebrate! Be part of Bonn’s very first tournament and help us make it legendary. Sign up now – we can’t wait to see you there! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYzNzI4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6111d603a3f42ad9b696e4a64eecc2b9664c2245/image.png)

Diese Competition ist der direkte Nachfolger der "Frankfurt Cube Days", die von 2012 bis 2024 stattfanden. Nun sind wir nicht allzu weit umgezogen in die Nähe von Nürnberg, wo wir wieder eine tolle Venue gefunden haben. Wie in der Vergangenheit möchten wir sowohl Anfängern, als auch erfahrenen Cubern eine gute Erfahrung ermöglichen. Die Events 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6 und OH werden im neuen Format "dual rounds" stattfinden, sofern das WCA Softwaresystem dies bis dahin unterstützt. Am Samstag Abend wird es wieder eine After-Comp geben, ganztägig Snacks und Getränke in der Venue und eine Cubing-Börse. Mehr dazu könnt ihr in den Tabs nachlesen. Wir feuen uns auf Euch. ###Dear competitors, Franconia Cube Days 2026 are open to every citizen from every nation. This competition is a direct successor of the "Frankfurt Cube Days" that originated in 2012. The new venue is near Nürnberg, which has good trafic connections by plane, train or car. Our goal is to create a great experience for beginners and advanced cubers aswell. You can stay at our "After-Comp" on saturday evening to have fun and to connect with other cubers. There will be snacks and beverages at the venue and also a cube-swap shop. Please have a look at the tabs for more information. We are looking forward to see you at the FCDs 2026.

Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije natjecanja. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja. ---- (EN) Zagreb Open 2026 is a competition that is held in Zagreb. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the competition organization. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.

Please pay attention to the **date and time zone** of your [location](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCSAC2026#70836-lugares-locations)! ​ Locations may be added until the **15th of May** 23:59UTC so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates#latin-america) in South America. ​ ---

items.name: RVA Spring 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc1Njg4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fb0442b987df250ca8c1fe99619c38d7a573dc42/RichmondSpring26FinalLogo-Photoroom.png) **This competition is a part of the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.cubeagainstcancer.org/) competition series in collaboration with [Ethan's Ohana](https://www.ethansohana.org/). We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube or STEM-related item, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RVASpring2026#72500-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.** **Notice of Filming and Photography: Please note that filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used in any format for any purpose worldwide in perpetuity by GANCube, TheCubicle, Ethan's Ohana, Mid-Atlantic Speedcubing, Local Television Networks and their affiliates and representatives. Further, by your presence, you grant permission for your likeness and voice to be included therein without compensation, credit, or other consideration. If you do not wish to be photographed, recorded, or appear under these conditions, you should not enter the event premises.** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. Additionally, we recommend you attend the Newcomer Tutorial at the beginning of the Competition. This competition is being held in the Mid-Atlantic Region (DC, DE, MD, NJ, NY, PA, VA, WV).
